fields.name: predictionId
fields.description: Deterministic id from Prediction.deriveId(eventId, modelName, modelVersion): 64 lowercase hex characters (SHA-256). Recomputes identically on replay of the same event against the same model version; not part of predictions' ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY, so it is not guaranteed globally unique on its own

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: The scored FeatureVector's own eventId -- the join key back to the feature vector this prediction was produced from

fields.name: eventTime
fields.description: The scored event's timestamp, copied from the feature vector, ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: modelName
fields.description: ModelRef.name of the model bundle that produced this prediction

fields.name: modelVersion
fields.description: ModelRef.version of the model bundle that produced this prediction

fields.name: modelSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of the model.onnx bytes that produced this prediction, 64 lowercase hex characters, copied from ModelRef.modelSha

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: Feature schema id the scored vector was built under, copied from the FeatureVector

fields.name: schemaHash
fields.description: SHA-256 content hash of that feature schema, 64 lowercase hex characters, copied from the FeatureVector

fields.name: score
fields.description: Probability read off the model's positive-class output column (ModelRef.positiveClassColumn), in [0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: decision
fields.description: The scoring use case's decision for this prediction. Deliberately not re-derivable from score and threshold alone by a consumer -- the comparison rule lives in exactly one place so it can change without this contract changing

fields.name: threshold
fields.description: The decision cutoff this prediction was scored against, copied from ModelRef.threshold, in [0.0, 1.0]

fields.name: inferenceMicros
fields.description: Measured duration of the scoring call, in microseconds; never negative

fields.name: qualityFlags
fields.description: Copied from the scored FeatureVector's own qualityFlags, so a prediction made on a degraded vector stays visibly degraded downstream

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: Emission time of this prediction, ISO-8601 UTC
